absorption.description: The golden hearts of an entity.
air.description: How many ticks an entity can still go without breath.
armor.description: The armor points of an entity.
async.description: Plays what is inside, or one command, on a track of its own while the story goes on.
async.track.description: The name @await and @cancel know the track by.
attribute.description: The value of an attribute with all its modifiers.
avoid.description: Keeps out of a zone when finding a path.
await.description: Waits until the tracks end; every one when none is named.
base-attribute.description: The base value of an attribute, without modifiers.
block-at.description: The block at a point; in the story level when no level is given.
block-id.description: The id of a block, such as minecraft:stone.
block-in-tag.description: Whether a block is in a tag, such as #minecraft:logs.
block-item.description: The item that places a block.
break-block.description: Breaks the block at a point.
break-block.drop.description: Drops the block as an item; what dropped stays after an undo.
call-define.description: Plays a @define and, when it returns a value, puts it into a variable.
call-define.name: Function
call.description: Plays from a label until @return, then comes back.
camera.description: Moves the player's camera to a point and turns it.
cancel.description: Stops a task started by a Parallel block.
checkpoint.description: A point the story can rewind to.
checkpoint.name: Name
choose.description: Offers the options and gives back the number of the one chosen, from 0.
collider-position.description: Where the middle of a collider is now; empty when there is none.
colliders.description: The names of the colliders of the model of an entity; empty without them.
command.description: Runs a vanilla command; {variables} are put in.
component.description: The value of a component of an item as NBT; empty without it.
count-items.description: How many items matching a filter a player has.
custom-data.description: The NBT of the minecraft:custom_data component.
custom-name.description: The name given to an item; empty without one.
cutscene.description: Plays a cutscene and waits until it ends.
cutscene.name: Cutscene
cutscene.time.description: How long to play it; the whole cutscene when left out.
damage.description: Hurts an entity; it can die of it, which is not undone.
day.description: How many days the world has lived.
define.description: A block @call plays by name; reading top-down skips it.
define.name: Name
dimension-id.description: The id of a dimension, such as minecraft:overworld.
dimension.description: A dimension by id, such as minecraft:the_nether.
effect-level.description: The level of an effect, from 1; 0 without it.
effect-seconds.description: How many seconds an effect has left; 0 without it.
effect.description: Gives an entity an effect such as minecraft:speed.
enchantment-level.description: The level of an enchantment of an item; 0 without it.
entity-data.description: The value under a key of the data of an entity; empty without the key.
entity-type.description: The id of the type of an entity, such as minecraft:zombie.
equip.description: Puts an item into a slot of an entity: a hand or a piece of armor.
equipment.description: What an entity wears or holds in a slot.
experience-level.description: The experience level of a player.
experience-progress.description: How far the player is to the next level, from 0 to 1.
fade-in.description: Covers the screen with a color.
fade-out.description: Takes the color off the screen.
fill.description: Fills a box with a block, as /fill does; 32768 blocks at most.
filter-component.description: Matches an item with a component; with a value only with that one.
filter-item.description: Matches this item; with Exact only one with the same components.
filter-matches.description: Whether an item matches a filter.
filter-not.description: Matches whatever the filter does not.
filter-tag.description: Matches any item of a tag.
find-player.description: A player on the server by name; empty when absent.
food.description: The food level of a player, from 0 to 20.
game-mode.description: The game mode of a player.
give-item.description: Gives a player an item; what does not fit drops at their feet.
give-levels.description: Adds levels of experience; fewer than none takes them.
has-all-items.description: Whether a player has enough of every listed item.
has-effect.description: Whether an effect is on an entity.
has-items.description: Whether a player has that many items matching a filter.
health.description: How much health an entity has.
held-item.description: What an entity holds in a hand.
hide-hud.description: Hides the HUD, all of it or only some of its layers.
hide-hud.only.description: The layers to hide; every one when left out.
ignite.description: Sets an entity on fire for a time; no time puts the fire out.
import.description: Lets @call play the functions of another story.
in-lava.description: Whether an entity is in lava.
in-water.description: Whether an entity is in water.
interact.description: Uses an entity, as a player clicking it with the right button.
inventory-items.description: Every non-empty stack of the inventory of a player.
inventory-slot.description: What lies in a slot of the inventory of a player.
inventory.description: A checkpoint keeps the player's inventory and puts it back on rewind.
is-day.description: Whether it is light in the world now.
item-block.description: The block an item places; air when none.
item-count.description: How many items a stack holds.
item-damage.description: How much durability an item has lost.
item-id.description: The id of an item, such as minecraft:diamond.
item-in-tag.description: Whether an item is in a tag, such as #minecraft:logs.
item-name.description: The name of an item as the game shows it.
item-request.description: How many items matching a filter are needed: a line of a quest list.
item.description: A stack of an item of the given size.
jump.description: Goes on from a label, here or in another story, and does not come back.
level-of.description: The dimension an entity is in.
look-at-entity.description: Turns to look at an entity and follows it with the eyes.
look-at.description: Turns to look at a point.
look-raycast.description: A ray from the eyes of an entity the way it looks; it does not hit the entity itself.
look.description: The unit vector an entity looks along.
lore.description: The lines of the lore of an item.
max-health.description: How much health an entity can have.
max-stack.description: How many such items fit in a stack.
message.description: Shows text in the chat of a player, or above the hotbar.
missing-items.description: The listed requests a player falls short of, with how many are missing.
move-through.description: Walks through the points in order.
move-to-entity.description: Walks up to an entity, following it, and waits until it gets there.
move-to.description: Walks to a point and waits until it gets there.
name: Name
name.description: The name of an entity as the game shows it.
nbt-find.description: The value at a path, as /data takes it: a.b[0].c.
nbt-flag.description: The flag of NBT: non-zero is yes.
nbt-get.description: The value under a key of a compound or at an index of a list.
nbt-has.description: Whether a compound has a key.
nbt-items.description: The elements of an NBT list.
nbt-merge.description: A copy of a compound with another merged in.
nbt-number.description: The number of NBT; 0 when it is not one.
nbt-put.description: A copy of a compound with a value under a key.
nbt-remove.description: A copy of a compound without a key.
nbt-set.description: A copy of NBT with a value at a path.
nbt-size.description: How many keys a compound or elements a list has.
nbt.description: NBT written as SNBT, such as {Count:3b}.
npc.description: Puts an NPC into the world and gives it back; taken away again when the story rewinds past it.
npc.id.description: The NPC to spawn, such as village:guard; a plain one when left out.
on-ground.description: Whether an entity stands on the ground.
pitch.description: Where an entity looks vertically, in degrees.
play-clamped.description: Plays an animation and holds its last frame.
play-looped.description: Plays an animation over and over until it is stopped.
play-once.description: Plays an animation once and waits until it ends.
play-ping-pong.description: Plays an animation forward, then backward, over and over.
play-sound.description: Plays a sound to a player.
play-sound.name: Sound
position.description: A checkpoint keeps where the entity stands and puts it back there on rewind.
push.add.description: Adds to the motion it has instead of replacing it.
push.description: Sets the motion of an entity, or adds to it: a jump, a knockback, a throw.
raycast.description: Casts a ray and tells what it met first: a block or an entity. A model with colliders is hit at its colliders.
raycast.ignore.description: An entity the ray passes through.
release-camera.description: Gives the camera back to the player.
remove-data.description: Removes a key from the data of an entity.
remove-effect.description: Takes an effect from an entity.
return.description: Goes back to where @call came from, with a value from a @define.
rewind.checkpoint.description: The latest one passed when left out.
rewind.description: Goes back to a checkpoint, taking back what was done since.
say.description: Shows a line and waits until it is read.
set-attribute.description: Sets the base value of an attribute such as minecraft:generic.movement_speed.
set-block.description: Puts a block at a point; undone, the old block is back with what it held.
set-data.description: Keeps a value in the data of an entity, where scripts, animations and UI read it.
set-food.description: Sets the food level of a player, from 0 to 20.
set-game-mode.description: Switches the game mode of a player.
set-health.description: Sets the health of an entity, up to its maximum.
set-inventory-slot.description: Puts an item into a slot of the inventory of a player; undoing returns the old one.
set-rotation.description: Turns an entity; a value left empty stays as it is.
set-time.description: Sets the time of day, from 0 at dawn to 24000; clocks only go forward.
set-weather.description: Turns the sky clear, rainy or stormy for a time.
set.description: Puts a value into a variable.
set.value.description: An expression; a command such as npc([0, 64, 0]) gives its result.
spawn-npc.description: Puts an NPC in the world and gives it back; a rewind of the story removes it.
spawn-npc.id.description: Which NPC to make, such as village:guard; without one it is always a new NPC.
spawn-npc.model.description: The path to the model of the NPC.
spawn-npc.name.description: The name over the head of the NPC.
stage.description: Plays a @State function of a script and waits for it.
stop-animation.description: Stops an animation, blending it out.
stop-looking.description: Stops looking at what it looked at.
take-all-items.description: Takes every listed item at once, only when there is enough of each.
take-items.description: Takes items matching a filter from a player, only when there are enough.
teleport.description: Moves an entity to a point at once.
temporary.description: What is inside is taken back at a checkpoint.
temporary.until.description: The next one when left out.
time-of-day.description: The time of the current day, from 0 at dawn to 24000.
timeout.description: What is inside gives up when the time is out.
to-nbt.description: A value as NBT: a number, text, flag, list or item.
use-block.description: Uses a block, as a player clicking it with the right button.
vehicle.description: What an entity rides; empty when nothing.
velocity.description: How an entity moves now, in blocks per tick.
wait-all-items.description: Waits until a player has enough of every listed item.
wait-interact.by.description: Only this player counts; anyone when left out.
wait-interact.description: Waits until a player clicks an entity with the right button. Gives that player.
wait-items.description: Waits until a player has enough items matching a filter.
wait-key.description: Waits until the player presses a key, such as e, space or left-shift; any key when none is named. Gives the key pressed.
wait-position.description: Waits until an entity comes near a point, or leaves it.
wait-position.leave.description: Waits until it is farther than the radius instead.
wait-use-block.description: Waits until a player clicks a block with the right button. Gives that player.
while.description: Plays what is inside over and over while the condition holds.
with-component.description: The same item with a component given as NBT.
with-count.description: The same stack with another count.
with-custom-data.description: The same item with other minecraft:custom_data.
with-damage.description: The same item with other damage.
with-enchantment.description: The same item with an enchantment; level 0 removes it.
with-lore.description: The same item with other lines of lore.
with-name.description: The same item with another name.
without-component.description: The same item without a component.
yaw.description: Where an entity faces horizontally, in degrees.
